QuestInfo.name: [MMT] Magical Miracle Time Pre-registration
QuestInfo.0:
Heroic World Miracle Time pre-registration is open!
Register to participate in Miracle Time on the day of your choice, between 12/22/2021 - 12/26/2021!

* Heroic World Miracle Time Guide:
- Register which day of the week-long event you'd like to participate on.
- Miracle Time perks will be applied at 3:00 - 4:00, 8:30 - 9:30, and 22:00 - 23:00 on the date you've signed up for.
- You can register once per world, and the date cannot be changed once registered.
- The registration tickets for each date are sold on a first come first serve basis, and 400 tickets will be restocked every 12 hours.

Pre-registration will be open from 12/17/2021 - 12/21/2021! Please stay tuned!
